name: resistance band 45 degrees hyperextension
description: A hyperextension on an angled bench with a band adding load for the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree hyperextension bench with your hips just over the pad.
Loop a band across your upper back and under your feet or the base.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them lightly.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch at the top.
